decisions.why: aperture drapes, op sheets, op towels and arm sleeves are general theatre consumables used in the operating room
Biogel synthetic and natural rubber gloves are Mölnlycke's surgical glove brand, not examination gloves, so they fit surgical gloves rather than the infection speciality's examination glove types
Hibiwash, Steriwave and Hibiclens are chlorhexidine-based skin disinfectant products
